notes.title: Veil Fights 13, 14, and 15
notes.notes:
Content
- Veil Fights 13, 14, and 15, with associated unlocks, are now available!
- The Lunar Essence upgrade that unlocks the Boffobop plant now also unlocks a Berry Shop item that allows you to automatically level plants.

QoL
- Two more loadouts are now available by default. The maximum number of loadouts you can purchase with Eternal Essence has increased by two.
- Hovering over Speed and Faith in the stats tab on the main screen while fighting a monster for whom that stat is relevant will now show additional information.
- The max number of purchases with Arena crests has increased.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where plants would require infinite growth at high levels.
- The Bestiary now correctly displays the number of drops per monster over one billion after unlocking uncapped reagent gain.

notes.title: Veil Encounters 11 & 12 Update
notes.notes:
Content
[list]
[*] Veil fights 11 and 12, and associated unlocks, are now available!
[*] A new purchase has been added to the lunar essence shop.
[/list]

Balance
[list]
[*]  The Primordian now no longer has a damage bonus when returning to full health from its passive ability.
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] The Veil now shows what action it will perform the next turn.
[*] Added 7 more accessory inventory slots
[*] Lunar Essence and Solar Essence are now visible on both Accessories tabs, rather than having to switch back and forth to see one or the other.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where card pack purchasing could break if you have enough glowing runes to buy more than 2.2 billion card packs.
[*] Fixed an issue where bonuses from Idols were available before unlocking them in Singularity.
[*] Recipe Ingredients now have smaller text to prevent text from overlapping.
[*] Increased size of text box for boon essence upgrades to prevent text from going out of the UI element.

notes.title: Veil Encounters 9 & 10 Update
notes.notes:
Content
[list]
[*] Two new Veil fights have been added, with unlocks for each!
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Materials should no longer overflow.
[*] The victory message for Arena fight 10 has been corrected.
[*] The text for Higher Plane now formats the amount of RP required from a rebirth.
[*] Fixed an issue where quest completions could overflow, resulting in no glowing runes being rewarded after a certain point and quest progress being shown as NaN / NaN. As part of the fix, you'll now see 0 quest progress when above 100,000 quest completions, but you'll still see the amount of quest progress required for a quest completion to gauge how many glowing runes you'll receive for a certain amount of progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Veil Encounters 7 & 8 Update
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] New battles are now available in the Veil!
[*] A new premium item is available in the shop upon unlocking Boons.
[*] Defeating Veil fight 6 now unlocks a new item in the Cosmic Ichor shop.
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Mana Extract now gives 5 mana per upgrade, up from 1.
[*] Mychorrizae now gives 20% plant growth per level, up from 10%.
[*] The Lassetarian's berry yield now doubles every 30 levels.
[*] Buildings now have reduced scaling above level 100,000. (I don't think this should affect many people who were playing the game normally, but this is likely to be more relevant with this update!)
[/list]


QoL:
[list]
[*] There is now a visual indication when an Accentuated Accesories bonus is active.
[*] Elixirs now show their ingredients in the tooltip on the Arena pre-fight screen.
[*] There is now an option to toggle breakdowns of calculations for singularity abilities
[*] You can now fight in the Arena up to 5 ascension levels above your previous highest level beaten.
[/list]

notes.title: Apotheosis Emblem Update
notes.notes:
QoL:
[list]
[*] Apotheosis Emblem is now used by double clicking it in your inventory, rather than dragging it to the Sacrifice Panel. This means Apotheosis Emblems can now be sacrificed to upgrade other accessories.
[*] Traveling to a location will now unlock the entry for the monster at that location in the Bestiary without having to defeat the monster.
[*] Added a panel to the Fertilizer upgrade screen in the Garden allowing multiple upgrades to be completed at once.
[*] The Supplicant's Band now shows the base cost reduction in crafting.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] The Rock Troll's Reform ability now has its heal value properly formatted.
[/list]

notes.title: Singularity and Island 4
notes.notes: [p]Content:[/p][list][*][p]Island 4 and a new feature, Singularity, are now available! Unlock them using the new Accessory available in the Lunar Essence store.[/p][/*][/list][p]Balance:[/p][list][*][p]Purification and Sabotage have had their cooldowns reduced to one second.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon unlocking a new island, that island's equipment will automatically be checked in equipment filters.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed text in the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Berries in the Berry Trade store are now properly formatted.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mischief Maker Bugfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing massive progress in Alchemy, Worship, and the Arena when opening the Mischief Maker's entry in the Bestiary. If you would like to revert these gains, you can try loading one of your backup saves; feel free to reach out through Discord or the support email on Steam if you need help with this process.
[*] Fixed an issue where Arena battles could not be started.
[*] Fixed an issue where quests weren't giving additional rewards above a certain threshold.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Sacred Power and Accessory Empowerment glyphs are now available from Futhark.
[*] Hovering a multiplier in Futhark no longer shows text associated with rebirth glyphs.
[*] Sacred Power and Accessory Empowerment glyphs will now highlight the associated offline gains text.
[*] Tweaked the rounding for the aura of relics in the reliquary so that rounding errors won't prevent you from meeting aura requirements.
[*] Fixed an issue where upgrading fertilizer to very high levels would result in integer overflow.
[*] Fixed an issue where using Eternal Recurrence glyphs to increase your number of rewarded plays above the maximum would cause you to accumulate more autorewards than you should when logging in.
[/list]

notes.title: Enemy Ascension Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Balance:
[list]
[*] Monsters from the Forest Tyrant onward have had their ascension costs significantly reduced, and the increase in cost per ascension has decreased from 1.8 to 1.6. The first time you log in, you will receive an Incense refund equal to the difference of the two costs.
[*] To compensate for the previous change, the XP multiplier for ascended monsters has decreased from 1.3 to 1.2 per ascension level.
[*] Some Premium purchases that have been powercrept have been buffed:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Enchanced Rebirth now also gives +5% RP per puchase.
[*] The Talent Refresh Amulet now gives +10% to your total TP.
[*] The supporter pack now gives +20 to all glyph types per daily gift, up from +10.
[/olist]

Reworks:
[list]
[*] The process for unlocking all of the features in Worship has been changed. Rather than having it all unlock at once, there is a sequence:
[*] At first, the only thing that is unlocked is Oq.
[*] Once you reach level 1 favor with Oq, the Reliquary and the Incense offerings will be unlocked.
[*] Once you use Incense to unlock a location on the map, the other deities and Gold Offerings with their associated relics will be unlocked.
[*] Once you level up another deity with Gold Offerings, Blessings and Oil Offerings with their associated relics will be unlocked.
[*] In game text will let you know what you need to do to unlock the next part.
[/list]

Content:
[list]
[*] All glyphs now have an additional upgrade tier.
[*] New glyphs for Sacred Power and Accessory Enhancement have been added.
[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] More materials can now be purchased at once in Construction.
[*] There is now a setting to not show a notification for a plant upgrade when you lack the berries to upgrade it.
[*] You can now left click an equipped piece of equipment to jump to it.
[*] Equipment filters have been added.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Reagent drops no longer round down your drop chance when considering offline gains, e.g., 278% drop chance will be considered as 278%, not 200%.
[*] The input for blessings will no refresh when your blessing level is changed by changing loadouts.
[*] Fixed an issue where the blessing level of a blessing loadout was being set to 1 when loading a game.
[/list]

notes.title: QoL and Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
QoL:
[list]
[*] Reagents that a monster drops will now be highlighted in your inventory when you are fighting that monster.
[*] Gemstones in the Reliquary that have had their type of location unlocked will now be highlighted in a different color.
[*] Hovering a button in World Access will now show you its hotkey in the tooltip.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Restored the HP and MP regen tooltip when you hover your HP and MP bar, which had been accidentally deactivated.
[*] Tripled glyph bonuses will no longer convert to double bonuses upon closing and reopening the game.
[*] You can no longer merge "equip in inventory" type accessories.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Recurrence Auto Rewards
notes.notes:
Content
[list]
[*] A new premium shop item that allows you to spend more glyphs at a time for an enhanced bonus is now available.
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] Added an Auto Reward feature to Eternal Recurrence, which allows you to gain saved rewards without having to go in and click the button. This feature can also give a "default" payout that is based on the amount of cards you have in your collection, but this will likely be substantially less than what you would earn by playing and saving a game.
[*] Added a use all button for Berry and Eternal Recurrence glyphs.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Names of loadouts within linked loadouts no longer need to be refreshed to display properly if they are changed.
[*] Rapid Fire can be equipped once inside the Arena, as intended.
[*] Fixed Hellion's Flame Breath ability having reverse cooldown and damage numbers.
[*] Rewards from Eternal Recurrence will now be formatted.
[/list]

notes.title: Lunar Shop Additions
notes.notes:
Content
Several new items are available for purchase in the Lunar Essence Shop

Balance
[list]
[*] The Accessory Empowerment formula has been adjusted to not grow as quickly at higher monster ascension levels
[*] Accessory Empowerment is now split between all equipped accessories with the same empowerment target (In other words, empowering multiple accessories will be slower proportional to the number being empowered)
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] SP per MP, Alchemy Brew Speed, and Accessory Empowerment have been added to the stat breakdown
[*] Added the ability to assign every part of your current loadout to a linked loadout
[*] The state amount of offering gains from a relic now reflects all offering-increasing effects
[*] An indicator showing accessory quality has been added.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a 0.96 multiplier was being applied to RP gained from rebirthing for players who have won the arena fight that grants RP per victory
[*] Fixed an issue where alchemy brew speed was being affected by achievements that give bonus class XP, rather than bonus brew speed
[*] Abbreviations for number above the septillions have been added
[*] The wording for Challenge Trials has been updated in a few places to make it clearer what the Supplicant's Band does
[/list]

notes.title: Accessories
notes.notes:
Content
[list]
[*] Five new monsters are now available to fight on Island 3.
[*] A new game feature, Accessories, is now available. Unlock it at one of the new map locations!
[/list]

Fixes
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Companion Stats Bugfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where "secondary stat" companion bonuses were suffering from integer overflow.

notes.title: Small Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players were seeing a Futhark notification prior to it being unlocked.
[*] Fixed an issue where closing the Futhark panel while the rewards were fading in or out would prevent the interface for starting a new game from appearing.
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking outside of the board in Futhark would attempt to place blocks.
[/list]

notes.title: Futhark
notes.notes:
This patch bring Futhark, a new minigame that gives glyphs and bottled time! The minigame is unlocked from a new dialogue early in the second island and can be accessed through the Daily Gift panel. In association with the new minigame, the patch also brings:

[list]
[*] A new premium shop item in the Second Island tab
[*] A new achievement
[*] A new option in the Settings to show when a Futhark play is available
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] Over 40 in-game achievements are now available to unlock! They can be viewed through the "Log" button at the top of the main screen.
[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] The panel detailing offline gains has been made lighter so that the text is easier to read.
[*] There is now a filter in your ER collection specifically for filtering out all cards that are not max rank.
[*] Oq Favor per Second from the Shrine is now shown on the Shrine panel.
[*] The amount of Bottled Time shown in Time Warp will now always round down, so you should have enough time to warp when it says you do.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Cleaned up some typos and removed the outdated info in the Gemstone hover text in the Reliquary that a refresh is necessary to level up Gemstones.
[*] Fixed an issue where Lightning Reflexes and Disarm were not reducing Gold Offering costs through the Apotheosis Blessing during active combat (they were only working offline)
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfix Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Entering the Arena now resets your HP, MP, the cooldowns from all of your abilities, and removes all buffs and debuffs, which should ensure runs with the same loadout have the same result.
[*] Resetting the Reliquary is no longer necessary to see your gemstones increase in level - it should happen automatically upon leveling up.
[*] The new counts in the Reagent Drops tab in the Bestiary now properly accounts for the number of enemy drops as well as the 1 billion drop cap.
[*] The amount of quest progress needed for very high quest reward tiers now accurately reflects the requirement. (The progress shown may still be a little wonky, especially for XP quests - but this typically isn't relevant for players who are getting 100,000+ runes from a single quest.)
[*] Fixed an issue where the Holy Infusion ability's Faith bonus was not being properly accounted for from AFK gains.
[*] Stats should now update immediately upon changing a loadout.
[*] Added a Discord button to the game's menu.
[/list]

notes.title: QoL Update
notes.notes:
QoL
[list]
[*] Relics not receiving enough aura will now be highlighted in orange.
[*] Moved Elixir Nullification out of enemy statblock
[*] Construction materials no longer jump back to the first set every time you open the page
[*] Counts of reagent drops will now be shown in the bestiary
[*] Added the ability to save a configuration of the Reliquary
[*] Added a button to remove all filters in the Card Collection
[*] The ascension bonus for knowledge and reagents can now be seen in the Bestiary
[*] When you unlock multiple knowledge bonuses at once, you can now see all of them in the preview (looking at you, Vermin King!)
[/list]

Balance
[list]
[*] Fewer oil offerings are needed to achieve blessing points above 36 points. Reaching higher blessing levels should be easier to achieve with a human lifespan.
[/list]

notes.title: Shrine
notes.notes:
Shrine

Content:
[list]
[*] A new unlockable is available on the World 3 map! Go to it to unlock a new building in Construction!
[/list]

Balance:

[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] Max MP for monsters has been removed from the Reliquary.
[*] The drop text and monster search elements have been adjusted so that they overlap less.
[*] Mana has been removed form the Bestiary, as all monsters have the same mana.
[*] Trailing 0's should be removed from very small numbers now, i.e. from base reagent drop rates of Island 3 monsters.-You can now hover a reagent in the drop list of a monster in the bestiary to see its reagent type.

notes.title: Third Island Arena Fights
notes.notes:
Content: 
[list]
[*] There's a new unlockable in World 3! Go to it to unlock two new arena fights!
[*] A new item for Worship is available in the shop.
[*] A new code is hidden somewhere in a game tooltip! There's an in-game and Discord announcement with the details.
[/list]

[*] The crest shop no longer shows how much time is left to the next crest when your generation is above one every 6 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: New Third Island Monsters
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] 5 new monsters are available on Island 3!
[*] Added an item to the berry trader store, available when the Class XP plant is unlocked, that allows you to retain some of your extra plant progress when leveling up a plant.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] A number of monsters have had their scaling adjusted when they appear in the UI.
[*] Alchemy and Offering glyphs should now appear with other active glyphs in the upper right part of the fight UI.
[*] Fixed the rat emperor's rage ability in the Arena.
[*] Adaptive Resistance in the Arena can now give immunity to pure damage.
[*] Changing companions through loadouts now changes the companion that appears in the icon in world access.

[*] Abilities that limit the amount of damage you can deal to monsters to a certain percentage of their max health now have a cap on the reduction of 90%.
[*] Ru trials have once again had their requirements adjusted: the change last week was a (big) overcorrection, so they have been adjusted back closer to their original value.

notes.title: Third Island Equipment Crafting Update
notes.notes:
Content / Features:
[list]
[*] 2 new unlockable features in the Third Island
[*] You can now filter by Island 3 reagents in Bestiary
[*] You can now trade Island 3 reagents for Goldenberries
[*] 2 new glyph types are now available after unlocking Alchemy and Worship
[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] Added a toggle to see purchased items in the berry shop
[*] Added a line of text to the Arena battle details showing what the unlockable for that fight was
[/list]

Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where you could upgrade past your relic shard cap (again!)
[*] Monsters will no longer use healing abilities when they are at full health
[*] Fixed an issue where relic level was not being preserved when expanding / collapsing the menu or between play sessions
[*] Fixed an issue where the ascension level in the text box would change to "-1" when coming to a location on Island 3 from somewhere without ascensions

notes.title: Third Island and Worship
notes.notes: A new set of monsters is now available on the Third Island! Go there to unlock the new Worship feature! The Third Island is unlocked once you have beaten the fourth battle in the Arena.

notes.title: Equipment UI Rework
notes.notes:
QoL
- The Equip and Crafting menus have been combined into one. The panel now takes up the entire screen, and has additional features: the ability to toggle between viewing base stats and effective stats of equipment, a section that allows you to assign and equip loadouts, and a section that shows the total stats gained from equipment.

Fixes
- The bottled time notification now updates upon logging in
- Fixed an issue where Oceanic Naga's abilities would have their cooldowns counting down prior to the start of the battle in the Arena.

notes.title: Arena Combat Log
notes.notes:
Balance
[list]
[*] The amount of reagents gained from one monster kill is now capped at one billion. (I don't think anyone has reached this cap yet, but this should prevent overflow errors from occurring further down the line - at least within human lifespans.)
[*] Increased diminishing returns on buildings at level 200+
[*] Passives which consume mana (Disarm, Lightning Reflexes) now give class XP.
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] There is a new "Combat Log" tab in the Arena which shows a log of your most recent combat.
[*] The Elixir being brewed for a particular Alchemy table is now a dropdown, allowing you to select one Elixir directly without having to remember its metal / processing combination.
[*] A panel has been added to rebirth perks to level them up multiple times.
[*] The maximum amount of reagents that can be exchanged for construction materials has been increased.
[*] The breakdown of glyph drop rates is now shown directly without having to open another window.
[*] Hovering over a plant that is not yet ready to upgrade will show the base berry cost when it is ready.
[*] The panel which shows your active companion's XP has been replaced with a panel that shows all companions' XP.
[*] Poison now ticks every second, rather than every 0.1 seconds, to reduce the amount of text popping up and to prevent Predictions from slowing down on poison enemies. Bleed effects (from the Bloodletter Elixir) are not affected by this change.
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] The name of Liselda's level 16 bonus has been changed to reflect its current effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where elixirs would be stretched out when they were not all unlocked.
[*] Added more space for token traits in Eternal Recurrence, so that more than 4 icons can be shown.
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Recurrence Animation Setting Update
notes.notes:
QoL:
[list]
[*] Added a setting to increase the speed of animations in ER
[*] Added a setting to notify when bottled time is full
[*] The "Sacrifice Golden Ichor" button has been removed
[*] You can now hover Quintessence generation to see how the value is calculated
[*] Added a "All" and "None" button to Arena to quickly add or remove all potions
[*] Losing in the Arena will now return you to the beginning of the fight you started, rather than the "Select Fight" screen
[*] Added a confirm box to resetting talents
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Using a saved reward in ER now gives you 60% of the saved game's rewards, up from 50%. It also now gives 100% of the Eternal Essence from the saved game
[/list]

notes.title: Hotkeys
notes.notes:
QoL:
[list]
[*] Hotkeys! Tabs and the most used windows can now be accessed with hotkeys, which can be rebound in the Settings.
[*] Hovering health and mana bars to show regeneration will now take into account Accelerated Healing and Channel.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Grasping Shades's immunity ability now works offline.
[*] Consume will no longer stop working on all enemies when dispelled off of one.
[*] Offline reagent gains will no longer be negated when they are above 2.2 Billion.
[*] Unused card reward save slots will now be hidden.
[*] Being killed by a multihit ability in Arena will no longer prevent you from healing to full and being returned to the "battle select" prompt.
[*] Being killed by poison for the purpose of calculating offline gains will no longer prevent offline gains and prediction from working.
[*] Squire Wriggles's passive now has the same percentage healing across Ascensions.
[/list]

notes.title: Post-Arena Fixes and Tweaks
notes.notes:
QoL:
[list]
[*] Starting an arena battle now heals you to full.
[*] You will now regenerate health after winning an Arena battle.
[*] You can now access Companions in the Arena when you are not actively fighting.
[*] The Elixir overview panel in Alchemy now shows the total Elixir Potency of each Elixir, rather than just the bonus from leveling it up. It can be hovered to show a breakdown of an elixir's potency.
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Berry gain from the Lassterian plant has been increased.
[*] The Gleaning Berry Investment has had its yield doubled.
[*] Dispelling Elixir now removes buffs from the opponent.
[*] Elixirs that have effects that depends on your own abilities' damage types have been buffed
[/list].

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Unstoppable Fury and other similar abilities will no longer leave a monster alive at 2 or 3 HP due to rounding issues.
[*] The Mychorrizae Berry Investment bonus should now work properly.
[*] The Emerald Dragon's posion ability has been fixed, and its "Inferno" ability now deals fire damage as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where the active bonus display was not working properly when multiple Companions are equipped.
[*] The Unguaardly plant has had its text set to properly round.
[*] Fixed an issue where elixirs at high potency had too high of an effect.
[/list]

notes.title: Arena Patch
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] The Arena is now available! Take on a series of challenging fights to unlock new features and bonuses! Unlocking the Arena will also unlock Alchemy, a subsystem that will help you battle in the Arena.
[*] 6 new Monsters have been added to the map.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where buying the Glowing Rune premium upgrade before taking your first quest could cause the transaction to not complete properly.
[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] Added the option to complete multiple Goldenberry trades at once.
[/list]

notes.title: Gigantic Germ Nerf
notes.notes:
Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] Saved rewards in Eternal Recurrence will be reset upon loading the game for the first time after this update.
[*] Added the option to reset your Golden Ichor cumulative total to 1 million in the Ichor Shop. You'll only see this if you already had at least 1 million golden ichor upon first logging in.
[*] The Gigantic Germ has been reworked: it no longer multiplies current Ichor rewards, but its Golden Ichor gain is increased, "Vicious" has been replaced with "Drain", and its stats have been adjusted.
[*] There is now a Golden Ichor multiplier in Eternal Recurrence which increases all Golden Ichor gained. It starts out at 1 and increases by 1 every 4th turn.
[*] Core Stat talent golden ichor bonus reduced from 4% per level to 3% per level.
[*] Armored and Drain waves in Eternal Recurrence have had their attack reduced.
[*] The third wave in Eternal Recurrence has had its stats reduced.
[*] The Grimy Gobbler has been reworked: it no longer has consume, but will cause you to draw an extra card when it dies.
[*] The maximum deck size in Eternal Recurrence has increased from 20 to 25. This can be further increased with Liselda's level 16 Companion bonus.-
[*] Unlocking diamond packs is now a purchase in the Golden Ichor shop.
[*] Madness Tincture in Eternal Recurrence gives Drain instead of Consume.
[*] Ring of Protection gives less health.
[*] Armorer's Anvil now costs 2 at all ranks and gives increased stats, but has "Duplicate" instead of "Repeating."
[*] Shadow Dagger has had the damage of both the main dagger and the generated daggers increased.
[*] Enemy stat scaling has been changed: stats will scale up slower on waves 10-20, the same as the previous rate on waves 20-30, and at a greater rate on waves 30+.
[*] Maneuver in Eternal Recurrence can now be used to move to a space that it is already occupied, in which case it will swap with the unit that was there.
[*] Life Potion hp per turn reduced to 2 at rank 5.
[/list]

Content:
[list]
[*] New "unique" cards have been added in Eternal Recurrence. These can't be upgraded, sold, or obtained from packs, but will have different means of acquiring them. One is available upon unlocking Eternal Recurrence, one is available in the Golden Ichor shop, and one is available in the Cosmic Ichor shop.
[*] Added a "News" tab at the top next to the Menu button for giving announcements in-game.
[/list]
UI / Naming Updates:
[list]
[*] Cleanse in Eternal Recurrence renamed to Dispel
[*] The fatigue damage dealt by the next card draw will now be shown in the Wave panel.
[*] The Reward Panel in Eternal Recurrence has been enlarged slightly so that there is less text spillover.
[*] You can now mouse over your deck in Eternal Recurrence to see which cards have yet to be drawn.
[/list]

Because there are some major balance changes that will affect Golden Ichor rewards, this update will come with the option of resetting your total Golden Ichor accumulated to 1 million. I leave it up to each player to decide what they think would be best for their experience, but the balance of future content may be off for those who choose not to reset. The game will have text noting how much you sacrificed.

notes.title: Minimimum Search Time Removal
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Card Library could fail to update upon purchasing a card.
[*] Effects that increase the strength of equipment bonuses will no longer apply to cooldown reduction.
[*] The ability to input a minimum search time has been removed.
[*] The Hunter Class Perk can now be toggled on and off in the ability select panel.
[/list]

The ability to specify a minimum search time was in response to an issue some players were having in which their previously working builds would be broken by the speed increase from the Hunter class perk. I've gotten some feedback that being able to set the time undermines a lot of the challenge in designing a build to fight a monster, so I am undoing the change. To help mitigate the issue that the speed increase from the Hunter Class Perk causes, it can now be toggled on and off.

notes.title: Minimum Search Time Patch
notes.notes:
Balance:

[list]
[*] Additional diminishing returns are now applied to Ichor bonuses at level 500+.
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] An Allocation Amount panel has been added to the Ichor shop that will allow you to add 10 or 100 levels at a time.
[*] A minimum search time can now be applied to monsters in the Bestiary, in the "Stats" tab of the monster.
[*] The name of a deck will be tinted red if it contains a card for which you have a card that is higher rank. The same will happen with the card itself.
[*] The Library / Card Purchase for Eternal Recurrence has been moved to its own tab, rather than being opened from the "Collection."
[*] If a card pack you open contains a higher-ranked version of a card you already had in one of your decks, that card will automatically be replaced in the deck.
[*] Dragging a Companion from Party to Active and vice versa will now swap them, rather than moving the Companion in the targeted slot to Inactive.
[*] 
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where unit visuals would disappear if they were killed too quickly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Cosmic Ichor plant growth bonus was not increasing growth by as much as intended.
[*] The Cosmic Ichor upgrade now gives Main XP properly, rather than Class XP.
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Gave a little extra space to Companion and Equipment icons in their respective menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Maneuver Condensing
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Gaining a Maneuver card when you already have one in your hand in Eternal Recurrence will now cause them to be combined. The same will happen with Feeble Froglings.
[*] Fixed an issue where cards could incorrectly appear in front of others in Eternal Recurrence.
[*] Fixed an issue where equipment icons were overlapping with text.
[*] Glyph drop breakdown now list the amount gained from the supporter pack.
[*] The Rebirth Glyph and Talent Reset Amulet have had additions to their descriptions to make clear that rebirthing with glyphs will not grant a talent reset.
[/list]

notes.title: Tactician Card Set Patch
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] The Tactician set is now unlockable from the map. 
[*] The Golden Ichor upgrade that unlock ER reward saving can now be upgraded twice. The second upgrade adds another save slot.
[*] Added a Supporter pack to the store that gives above-rate Eternal Essence and extra glyphs from the Daily Gift.
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Ichor scaling begins having diminishing marginal returns at level 25, with the growth reaching its slowest at level 250.
[*] Building scaling now has diminishing marginal returns at level 20, with the growth reaching its slowest at level 100.
[*] The Maneuver card has been reworked (and there are now many more ways to gain Maneuver cards in the new set!)
[*] Broodlord has received an additional ability: its next attack will hit twice after a Broodling has been killed.
[*] Divine Bell has had its cost at ranks 1-4 reduced.
[*] Lackeyderm has had its attack at ranks 1-3 increased.
[*] The Axe of Flinging has had its damage and golden ichor values increased.
[*] The Fetid Fungus has had its base health increased.
[*] Sacrificial Dagger has been reworked: it now gives the stats of the sacrificed unit to a randomly friendly unit, up to a cap determined by the card rank.
[*] The option to reset talents when using rebrth glyphs has been removed.
[*] Spiffany's level 1 Companion effect has had its value reduced by one third.
[*] Kersei's level 16 Companion Effect has had its damage bonus decreased.
[*] Goldenberry and RP plant harvests have had their base values reduced slightly, but now scale linearly with plant level.
[*] 
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Spectral Assassin now scales with Dex, as intended.
[*] Updated the health and mana regen tooltips.
[*] Cards will now spread out more if you have more than 10 in your hand, so that it doesn't become difficult to select a card you want.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Save Reward button after a game of Eternal Recurrence would permanently disappear after playing a practice game.
[*] You'll no longer receive a Water notification after purchasing the Irrigation System.
[*] The "healing" state will now immediately end if you unequip Accelerated Healing.
[*] Fixed overlapping text in the credits.
[*] Tooltips on notification on World Map features have been combined to prevent inconsistent behavior.
[*] Tooltips will now avoid going above the top of the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where plant growths could become NaaN if the device's clock was earlier than the last logout.
[/list]

QoL:
[list]
[*] Berry glyphs now show you how many Berries you will get from using them in the Glyph table.
[*] The Water All button will now disappear after purchasing the Irrigation system.
[*] Initiating a purchase will now show the "Waiting for Server" message in the tooltip and prevent a button from being clicked, to prevent accidental excessive initiations from resulting in a lockout.
[/list]

Save System:
[list]
[*] Backups will now be saved every 1 hour of active play time, in addition to when you start a new play session, to protect progress during long play sessions.
[*] A new save will now be created in a temporary file and then moved to the Autosave.save file. This change will not generally be noticeable, but it should greatly reduce the risk of a save file being corrupted or destroyed if a crash happens while the game is saving.
[/list]

notes.title: Stat Breakdown Patch
notes.notes:
QoL:
- You can now view breakdowns of values for formulas in the Stats menu.
- There are now settings to show notifications when plants can be upgraded, plants need to be watered, a rewarded play is available in ER, and when a daily gift is available.
- Buttons have been added to show the exact drop rates and values of glyphs.
- The button to open the Companions panel will now show whichever companion you have as your active companion, rather than just always showing Kersei.

Bugfixing:
- Active combat has had some tweaks so that active and predicted actions will be the same in some edge cases. 
- The default frame rate is now equal to your device's, since that was causing an issue for a couple of people. There is a setting to return it to half the frame rate for performance.
- You will not longer see a notification for an ability being unlocked if you haven't reached the Companion level required to unlock it.

Balance:
- The Rebirth time factor has been changed to more greatly reward longer rebirths.

notes.title: Daily Gift Patch
notes.notes:
Content:
[list]
[*] The Daily Gift is here! It is unlocked at the same location as the class XP talents. Every day, you will gain a gift which contains 5 eternal essence. The gift also contains a number of Glyphs, and different types of glyphs can be used for different bonuses. Each gift will contain one Omniglyph, which can be used to upgrade the average amount of other types of glyphs you get from the gift.
[*] Autosaves will now occur every 10 seconds, rather than every 5 seconds, and the game will automatically autosave on making a premium purchase.
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] The game will now show a notification when autosaving.
[*] Explosive Compound has been renamed Volatile Compound so that it doesn't overlap with other text.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Soul Shock will now apply its mana drain effect prior to dealing damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where Kersei's high RP rebirths could start stacking before you had unlocked the bonus.
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Changed the way frame rate is limited: the game will try to maintain half of your device's frame rate, i.e. if your device has a refresh rate of 60 fps, the game will try to maintain an fps of 30. (According to Unity's documentation, the previously used method could cause frame pacing issues on desktop applications.)
[/list]

notes.title: QoL and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Balance
[list]
[*] Offline reagent gains will now always give the expected value rather than sometimes doing a probability calculation.
[/list]

QoL
[list]
[*] Rather than removing the new game button, if the game detects a save, the new game button will appear in the upper left hand corner.
[*] When a steam ID cannot be determined for a play session (this can happen if you open the game from the taskbar) the game will search for saves and ask you which one you'd like to load.
[*] Quest progress is now shown in the offline gains.
[*] Added the ability to switch between abbreviated and scientific notation.
[*] Added a setting for the maximum number of digits shown after a decimal point.
[*] Your health and mana bars now show a tooltip giving your health and mana regen rate when hovered.
[*] Hovering over a reagent in the filters in the Bestiary shows you which type of reagent it is.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it impossible to draw rank 4 rare cards.
[*] The knowledge counter setting now also creates a knowledge bonus counter in the bestiary.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] The rogue level 40 ability now scales with Rogue Lvl, rather than Warrior Lvl.
[*] The rogue class XP talent's cost will now scale like an XP talent, rather than like an armor talent.
[/list]

Text / UI
[list]
[*] Made the templating in the Battle Provisions card more consistent.
[*] Fixed a typo in the "Sacrificial Blade" card description.
[*] The "Increase Mana Cost" effect now gives the increase rather than the total value for mana cost.
[*] Companion loadouts will no longer be visible before companions are unlocked.
[*] The rogue class XP talent will be hidden until the rogue is unlocked.
[*] The text next to quest refreshes has been reworded.
[*] Abilities which have both an effectiveness and mana penalty when underleveled will have the text combined and shortened to alleviate the text being cut off.
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Update
notes.notes:
Content:
- Added the Rogue class. It is available upon unlocking Eternal Recurrence.
- Added a Companions section to Loadouts.
- Expanded the Select section of the Bestiary and added filters and sorting. You can click on a reagent in the inventory to open the Bestiary with that reagent selected as a filter.

Bugfixing:
- Aliana's level 1 Companion bonus should now work properly.
- Divine Bell should now give the correct amount of Eternal Essence.
- Fixed an issue that would cause you to lose an ER play when saving a card game reward.

Performance:
- The target frame rate of the game has been set to 30 FPS.

UI:
- A new option in the settings allows you to toggle a counter which shows the number of knowledge bonuses unlocked in an area on the map.
- When opening the Change Name screen, your name should now properly be already in the text box.
- Abbreviated numbers will now show up to 4 digits, with trailing zeros being removed.
- Fixed a bug where additional companions slots from the Orb of Summoning would not be displayed.
- Rebirth upgrade panels are now aligned to the center.
- Added a Craft And Equip button next to the Craft button.

Balance:
- The minimum search time for a monster has been reduced to 1 second.
- The Spiky Helm now gives a damage% bonus.
- The thresholds for gaining Glowing Runes from class XP quests have been reduced.

Text:
- Energy Drain's name and description have changed so that it doesn't suggest you gain the mana you destroy on the enemy.
- Items in the premium shop will now show by how much their price increases.

notes.title: Companions Update
notes.notes:
Content:
- The Companions feature is now available! Unlock it on the map in the second continent. Equip Companions to the active or party slots for them to gain XP, which will unlock powerful bonuses!
- 4 new monsters are now available.
- A new code has been added! See the "code-hunt" channel in Discord for how to find it.

Balance:
- The "Revel in Death" talent has had its base bonus reduced, but it now scales with STR.
- Armor talents have had their cost reduced by 50%.
- Sporegon has had its on-death ability reduced from 80 to 60 damage.
- Reduced the cost of the "Saved Reward" feature for Eternal Recurrence from 1000 to 300.
- Monsters in Karyd, the second island, now give class XP for all abilities rather than just one as their knowledge reward.

QoL:
- Links to the relevant section in "how to play" have been added in various parts of the UI.
- If the game detects a save, the "New Game" button will no longer appear to avoid it being selected accidentally. I want to do a few things to rework the main screen UI, and this is just a temporary measure to make sure players don't accidentally create a new game. If you want to start a new game now, you'll have to move or delete your Autosave file.
- Bottled time now shows your current maximum, rather than the maximum if you purchase every upgrade.

Bugs:
- Removed an issue that made it possible to receive negative kills for monsters in the Bestiary.
- The quest text now correctly states that you will receive Glowing Runes for completing texts.

notes.title: Bestiary Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue causing the Bestiary to break when opened from a zone without monsters.

Fixed an issue where accepting a quest while rebirthing wouldn't update XP displays.
